reference_credit: Gustav Seitz, Portrat Thomas Mann, bronze portrait 1954; Berlin cast unveiled 2007, Strasse der Erinnerung, Berlin-Moabit. Photograph: Molgreen, 11 April 2024, CC BY-SA 4.0.
rights_basis: Photograph and cutout: CC BY-SA 4.0. Separate sculpture basis: German UrhG section 59 for a two-dimensional photograph of permanently installed public art, with sections 62 and 63 on alterations and attribution. Masking removes surroundings, not sculptural features; scaling is proportional. This is not a license from the sculptor or a worldwide sculpture-rights waiver. The former AI-assisted image remains excluded from public distribution.

Skulpturen avbildas med stöd av tysk panoramafrihet (UrhG § 59); fotografens licens är inte en separat licens till skulpturen.

OrbitUI: bakgrunden bortmaskad och bilden proportionellt skalad. Inga genererade skulpturdetaljer eller färgändringar.
framing: The bronze head, neck and compact mounting block are retained. The wide mounting plate and granite column are excluded; no new base is drawn.
method: Original photograph pixels, hand-traced silhouette with GrabCut edge refinement; alpha masking and proportional Lanczos resizing only. No generative reconstruction, recolouring or invented anatomy.
